ships_to_evidence.which_page_governs: /policies/shipping-policy governs. It is the store's legal shipping policy (linked in the footer under ABOUT & LEGAL > Shipping Policy) and it makes a closed statement - 'We currently ship to the following nations:' followed by a finite list. /pages/shipping is a marketing page headed 'Global Shipping' whose own text hedges ('4-10 Day Shipping to Most Countries') and whose regional tables give transit bands. A closed enumeration in the legal policy outranks a hedged marketing table, so where the two disagree the policy decides.
